W1-D1.decision: MARS SEARCH PPC PRODUCTION LIFECYCLE V1 — APPROVED

W1-D3.title: Project Manifest
W1-D3.decision: Every Search PPC project must have a valid lifecycle state manifest before lifecycle work proceeds

W1-D4.title: Entry-Point Enforcement
W1-D4.decision: Web-GPT and Cursor tasks must identify project ID, current lifecycle stage, completed approved stages, authoritative inputs, blockers, allowed current work, forbidden downstream work

W1-D5.title: Missing Requirements
W1-D5.decision: Missing evidence must produce BLOCKED — LIFECYCLE REQUIREMENT NOT MET; no invented substitutes

W1-D6.title: Operator Manual Work
W1-D6.decision: Mass phrase-by-phrase operator classification is prohibited as the default production workflow
allowed_exceptions: benchmark construction under separate approved process

W1-D7.title: Corvonero
W1-D7.decision: Create read-only lifecycle manifest; do not resume production

notes: Wave 1 implementation authorized; OPERATIONAL status requires operator review after Wave 1 report.
